Nora (People Ops): Heads-up: we've rolled out a small handbook update about mandatory compliance training cadence. New rule: managers must ensure direct reports complete the anti-harassment + data-privacy microcourses within 30 days of their 1st day or role change. See FAQ + CSV tool here: https://redwood.hr/handbook/compliance-cadence. Please confirm by Fri 05/02.

Priya (Engineering Manager): Thanks. For internal transfers (same company, new team), does the 30-day clock reset?

Nora (People Ops): Yes, if the role change alters responsibilities or data access. Use the "role_change" flag in the attestation CSV.

Carlos (Talent): I'm prepping a list of hires in May and will tag transfers separately. Will attach CSV here when ready.

hr-bot: Compliance export queued: compliance-hires-2470001111.csv -> s3://redwood-ops/exports/2026/05/. ETA ~1m.

Sam (People Ops): We've also published an optional manager checklist and a short drop-in Q&A session on Thu 9am PT. If anyone needs a bulk status pull, DM me the manager email and I'll run it.

Priya (Engineering Manager): Can managers delegate completion reminders to ICs or do we need a manager signature on attestations?

Nora (People Ops): Managers must attest completion for their team. Delegation for reminders is fine, but the attestation form requires a manager sign-off (email + manager_id).

Priya (Engineering Manager): Uploaded my CSV with 12 folks and two internal transfers. File: s3://redwood-ops/exports/2026/05/priya-compliance-2470001111.csv

Sam (People Ops): Got it, running ingestion. Confirmation: JOB-CL-2470001111. We'll notify you if any employees show incomplete courses older than 45 days.

Carlos (Talent): Thanks 44d will coordinate offer letters to include the new timeline.
thread_text_preview: Nora: handbook update - managers must ensure anti-harassment + data-privacy microcourses completed within 30 days of start or role change. CSV tool and office hours posted. Managers must attest.
